    Residue maps for chosen indecomposables over an algebraically closed field #

    The finite tau-category data already records that every chosen indecomposable has a local endomorphism ring. Over an algebraically closed field, the local algebra residue construction supplies its unique scalar residue map. The categorical radical criterion identifies the kernel with the diagonal categorical radical.
